posts.title: Powerpoint® is completely backwards
posts.description: The slide-oriented user interface pattern used by PowerPoint® and similar tools incentivises the wrong user behaviour for writing effective presentations. As a consequence, PowerPoint® presentations tend to end up as awful “Death by Powerpoint” experiences unless users actively work against their tools’ shortcomings. Instead, presentation software should be much more like blogging.

posts.title: Guidance for system administrators
posts.description: A few times in recent years, I’ve found myself wanting to write advice for other, perhaps more junior, systems administrators to try to capture the principles and values that I think are important for people in my line of work. Here’s what I’ve got so far, with thanks to all the wise friends and colleagues I’ve had over the decades.
